content_sections.heading: NCST Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 20025/35/2023-NCST gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCST notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territory or statutory or autonomous organisations or public sector undertakings or recognised Universities or recognised research institutions; (a)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in level 10 (Rs. 56100-177500/-) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and; Masters Degree in Social Work or Sociology or Economics or Anthropology or Social Anthropology or Applied Anthropology or Statistics or Psychology or Geography or Mathematics (with Statistics) from a recognised University or Institute Experience: Two years' experience of conducting survey or research in the field of social welfare including analysis of data and preparation of reports. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Only officers whose services can be spared immediately on their selection may apply. Applications must be forwarded through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NCST Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay of the selected officer will be regulated in accordance with DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2008-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. Deputation for a period of four (4) years initially, which can be curtailed or extended depending on requirement, with consent of the officer and approval of the lending department. Period of deputation including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before shall ordinarily not exceed four years. The usual deputation terms will be applicable.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the format at Annexure Attested photocopies of complete ACRs/APARs for the last five (5) years Vigilance clearance Separate integrity certificate Statement showing details of major/minor penalties imposed, if any, during the last 10 years Certificate filled in by the parent office/department

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCST Recruitment 2027 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the format given at the Annexure (Performa for Application for the Post of Deputy Director). Get the Certificate in the form filled in by the parent office/department. Forward the application through proper channel by e-mail to [email protected] and [email protected] . Enclose attested photocopies of complete ACRs/APARs for the last five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and statement of penalties of the last 10 years. Send the hard copy with all signed documents by post to Sh. Tajinder Singh Bal, Under Secretary, NCST Division, Ministry of Tribal Affairs, New Delhi-110001, to reach before the last date. Email it on or before 11 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Officers, once selected, will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature. Applications received after the last date or found incomplete will not be considered. Applications not accompanied by all the requisite documents will not be entertained. Eligibility conditions may also be seen on the Ministry of Tribal Affairs website (www.tribal.nic.in).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Deputy Director.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 11 January 2027. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 11 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 67700-208700 ).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers whose services can be spared immediately on their selection may apply. Applications must be forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation.

faq.answer: Deputation for a period of four (4) years initially, which can be curtailed or extended depending on requirement, with consent of the officer and approval of the lending department. Period of deputation including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before shall ordinarily not exceed four years. The usual deputation terms will be applicable.
